messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick post-AH follow-up — thanks for coming. Capturing a few clarifications, links, and owners from the Q&A so nothing falls through the cracks.

Ava (CEO): Slides + recording: https://redwood.ai/allhands/2026-q1 (slides at top, timestamps in notes). Recording will be up in an hour.

Diego: Re: runtime cost optimizations — we will publish the batching/quantization playbook this week. Short version: start with per-route batching=auto, enable 4-bit quant for non-critical models.

Rina: Can we get a concrete retention policy for analytics and traces? Legal asked during the Q&A.

Priya: Action: I'll draft a 3-tier retention proposal (prod telemetry = 90d, traces = 30d, eval artifacts = 365d) and share in #eng-security for review by Friday. @Ava @Diego if that timeline works.

Ava (CEO): Thanks @Priya — timeline is fine. We'll need an exec summary for customers who asked about data residency.

Sam: Quick ops clarification on rollouts — can confirm canary windows will default to 15m with 5% traffic for Dedicated. We should add a toggle in Console.

Diego: Adding to roadmap item: console rollout toggles + telemetry flag. Owner: @Sam. ETA: sprint 2.

Rina: On privacy questions during AH: we'll provide a short FAQ and link to the Private deployment checklist. Drafting the FAQ now.

Priya: Putting a short retention snippet for public FAQ: ```Retention: telemetry 90 days; audit logs 365 days (configurable); customer-managed storage recommended for regulated workloads.```

Ava (CEO): Customer ask about SLAs for Dedicated — we committed to a roadmap decision: baseline SLA details drafted by legal/solutions. Owner: @Diego to circle back with draft by next Tuesday.

Sam: Noted one follow-up from infra: need clearer guidance on model variant fallbacks (latency vs cost). I'll spin up a short doc and tag infra leads.

Diego: For action tracking, created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/1423 — contains owners and sub-tasks for retention, console toggles, and SLA draft.

Rina: +1 on GH issue. Will add the FAQ PR to that issue.

Priya: I'll post the retention proposal to #eng-security once the first draft is ready.

Ava (CEO): Awesome. Final asks: a 1-page customer-facing summary for the privacy questions (owner: @Priya), a short ops-runbook for fallbacks (owner: @Sam), and SLA draft (owner: @Diego). Please update the GH issue with check-ins.

deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.ai/recordings/1851234567 (transcript available).

Rina: Thanks — will review transcript for Q&A snippets to add to FAQ.

Sam: Will add console toggle follow-up to the sprint board and ping infra leads.

Diego: Closing loop here — will post a short note in #customers-success once SLA draft is ready.

Ava (CEO): Thanks all. If anyone's missing an owner, ping me directly. :sparkles:
